text: If every bee on Earth disappeared, your breakfast would look very different by next year.
That's because bees carry pollen from flower to flower, and that's how lots of plants make fruit.
Say goodbye to cheap apples, blueberries, cherries, and almonds. Almond farms rely almost entirely on bees.
Even burgers and milk could cost more, because cows eat alfalfa, a plant farmers grow with help from bees.
And your clothes? Cotton plants do better with bees too.
Coffee lovers wouldn't be happy either. Visits from bees help coffee plants grow more beans.
In some places, people already pollinate fruit trees by hand, using tiny brushes, one flower at a time.
But you wouldn't starve. Rice, wheat, and corn are pollinated by the wind, not bees.
And here's the crazy part. Chocolate would survive! Cocoa flowers are pollinated by tiny flies called midges.
Still, without bees, food would cost more, and meals would be a lot less colourful.
So next time a bee buzzes past you, don't panic... just let it bee.
